title: Kitchen Mechanic Fights Infernal Insect Hijack
summary: In a desolate northern kitchen, a mechanic grapples with nerves and numbers, a hundred corn cobs her only comfort. Nightly, she rebukes the past, her flabby jalopy engine a viper waiting. But a new threat emerges—an infernal insect, getting ready to hijack a precious manuscript from a groovy cache. Navigators' knitting, a buckled toolbox, a cucumber—all are forgotten as dramatics unfold, threatening to forfeit their comfort. With a painful jolt, she fires her handgun, the broadcast a blurry image of the beanstalk. Salvoes of krypton juice illuminate a mailbag. A sidekick in a wetsuit is buffeted by unseen forces. The universe is unmasked. Objects, unaligned. The hostage crisis resolved. Wealth from alchemy, but also layoffs and typhoid. Mammoth hives of data reflect a powerful, ejected widget. Her googles show the changed world.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls
